content:
A near-light-speed particle propulsion system and a spacecraft using it - China patent

#ufotwitter

🚀 Core idea

The patent describes a space propulsion concept where:

A spacecraft accelerates charged particles (like ions or plasma) to extremely high speeds (approaching the speed of light).

These particles are then ejected as a beam to generate thrust.

The system uses components similar to a particle accelerator (electric/magnetic fields to accelerate particles).

In short:
👉 It’s basically a particle-beam rocket engine concept.

⚙️ Main components described

From the patent content, the system includes:

A particle source (produces ions or charged particles)
An acceleration structure (electric or electromagnetic fields)

A beam emission system (directs particles out the back)

A power supply system (provides huge energy required)

The spacecraft would carry or generate energy to accelerate these particles and produce thrust.

Key claim is that particles are accelerated to relativistic speeds (close to the speed of light), which in theory:

Gives extremely high exhaust velocity
Could provide very efficient propulsion (high specific impulse)

Patent Application is filed by Ningbo Institute of Material Technology and Engineering of CAS, Northwest Institute of Nuclear Technology
